legacy_migration.trigger: LOCKED-SCRIPT-GATED: a project-original multi-person control space requires legible opposing zones, a visible body-state rearrangement and one light/space update; command, custody and authority meanings must already exist in the locked script
legacy_migration.directing_decision: HYPOTHESIS: establish the room in shared reverses, isolate only the bodies/objects whose visible state changes, then use one project-original light or spatial reset; never copy this source facility, wardrobe, props, displays or event
legacy_migration.coverage: project-original wide registration → two or three state-relevant singles/relations → shared blocking update → one light/space reset
legacy_migration.blocking: keep console/door equivalents on stable project-original sides; show hands/objects only when required; never infer rank from costume or frame dominance
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: source observation only: S001–S024 alternate 24 shots before S025–S030 light/space updates; durations are descriptive, not defaults
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK: audio not auditioned; commands, alarms, impacts, silence, dialogue and sound-led cuts UNKNOWN
legacy_migration.applicability: original scenes whose locked script requires both geography and a visible multi-body/object/light state transition
legacy_migration.non_applicability: single-person work; no authored state rearrangement; geography already established; or a continuous master preserves every required state
legacy_migration.failure_mode: coverage can over-fragment a simple state change, drift hands/objects, or visually imply hierarchy/coercion absent from the script
legacy_migration.counterexample: SOURCE-OBSERVED / different-trigger context exclusion: S058 holds one older face/object view for 11.875s instead of re-registering the room; this does not establish a same-trigger contrary case, which remains pending
legacy_migration.unknown: roles, exact identities, command, coercion, authority transfer, object function, dialogue, sound, simultaneity and authorial cut intent
legacy_migration.ai_risk: camera=HIGH for multi-axis shared/reverse/light reset; performance=HIGH for coordinated body/hand states; continuity=HIGH for room topology, visual IDs, object and lighting state
legacy_migration.fallback: camera HIGH: simplify to one locked project-original master plus one fixed insert; performance HIGH: reduce to one explicit project-original body-state change; continuity HIGH: use project-original IDs and state checkpoints
legacy_migration.confidence: MEDIUM: visual pattern occurs once in one source; semantics and transfer trigger remain locked-script-gated

legacy_migration.trigger: LOCKED-SCRIPT-GATED: a project-original crowd reaches an exterior threshold where body separation from an edge and a terminal scale reset are required; jump/fall, rescue, swimming and outcome must be authored and independently verified
legacy_migration.directing_decision: HYPOTHESIS: register the opening from behind, show only visually necessary edge/body-state units, alternate restrained close relations if script-required, then end on a project-original distant spatial state
legacy_migration.coverage: rear threshold wide → high edge state → one close relation/2D-overlap check, with any physical contact independently locked by the project script and safety plan → low or high body-separation view → distant exterior geometry
legacy_migration.blocking: keep edge plane and water/ground side explicit; never convert 2D overlap into force/contact, or downward motion into voluntary jump/safe landing without evidence
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: source observation only: S104–S121 uses threshold, edge, alternating crowd singles, two visible downward separations and two terminal top-down exterior views
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK: calls, breath, splashes, impact, silence, music and sound bridges UNKNOWN
legacy_migration.applicability: original scripts that require a visible threshold/edge transition and a terminal geographic consequence state
legacy_migration.non_applicability: no approved edge action; physical safety cannot be represented; outcome must remain withheld; or a ground-level master is the authored endpoint
legacy_migration.failure_mode: generated bodies may duplicate/deform, imply pushing/rescue, fabricate survival, or turn an ambiguous downward separation into a specific action/outcome
legacy_migration.counterexample: SOURCE-OBSERVED / same visible edge-state trigger, contrary scale: S118 uses a low exterior angle for downward body separation whereas S108 uses a high edge view; either can preserve the edge state, so neither scale is universal
legacy_migration.unknown: identity, voluntary/involuntary cause, physical contact existence/force, dialogue, ability, relationship, jump/fall/landing, swimming, survival, destination, sound and causal linkage to prior zones
legacy_migration.ai_risk: camera=HIGH for edge geometry and extreme-high reset; performance=HIGH for crowd/2D-overlap/downward-body staging, with physical contact only when independently locked by the project script and safety plan; continuity=HIGH for edge side, group tracks, water state and outcome boundary
legacy_migration.fallback: camera HIGH: use one locked project-original edge wide and one static distant endpoint; performance HIGH: split the project-original body state before/after without simulating a fall; continuity HIGH: use project-original crowd/edge state cards and leave outcome explicitly UNKNOWN unless locked
legacy_migration.confidence: MEDIUM: visible scale alternatives and state progression occur once; action meaning/outcome remain UNKNOWN and script-gated
